title: Vacant rooms/beds view
description: Filterable view of vacant beds by hostel/floor.
acceptanceCriteria: Vacant beds are listed correctly and update immediately after checkout/onboarding

history.note: Ticket created from initial DESIGN.md feature breakdown.

Starting. AC1 explicitly asks for immediate updates after checkout/onboarding, so this one gets genuine Flow reactivity (combine() over each room's live bed Flow) rather than the one-shot-fetch pattern used elsewhere - avoids the retained-ViewModel staleness class of bug already hit twice this session (LODGY-11, LODGY-20).

Built VacantViewViewModel/VacantViewScreen, grouped by floor with an 'All floors' + per-floor filter chip row, wired as a drill-in from the Dashboard's 'Vacant beds' tile (now clickable). Reactivity: combine() over each room's bedRepository.getByRoomId Flow, so any bed's status flipping (checkout frees one, onboarding occupies one) re-emits the whole list live, satisfying AC1 literally rather than just 'correct on next screen load'. AC2 (floor filtering) is a plain client-side filter over the combined list. Caught two real bugs before shipping: (1) my first draft placed the filter Row and the list as two SEPARATE direct children of Scaffold's content slot instead of wrapping both in a Column - Scaffold's content is a Box internally, so they'd have overlapped/rendered on top of each other; audited every other list+filter screen in the app (Invoices, Tenants) and confirmed this was the only instance. (2) a leftover brace from refactoring StatCard into StatCard+StatCardContent broke the build entirely - fixed before it ever reached a commit. `gradlew assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL, clean rebuild after both fixes. On-device pass still queued - this one in particular deserves an actual click-through given the overlap bug I just caught by re-reading, not by seeing it render.

PASS - no overlap, filter row and list render as separate rows correctly. Opened via the Home dashboard's "Vacant beds" tile: listed every vacant bed correctly grouped by floor, with Room 101/102's occupied beds correctly excluded. Filtered to "Ground" (a floor with no rooms): "No vacant beds right now." - filter works (AC2). Checked out Ravi Kumar afterward and re-opened this screen: Room 101 - Bed A reappeared in the list without needing to force-refresh - live Flow reactivity confirmed (AC1).
